card: Refactors the make_tx helper in miniminer_tests to use standard vector methods and constructors instead of resizing and manual indexing. It simplifies test transaction construction as part of issue #36692. The change is test-only and has no impact on node behavior.
changed_since_previous: Now includes the diff, confirming the use of emplace_back and vector::assign with CTxOut constructor calls; no functional change since the previous description.
evidence: Author notes this is part of #36692 ('Declarative construction of test data') (PR description)
problem: The unit test helper imperatively resizes transaction input and output vectors and sets fields individually in index loops, which is more verbose than standard vector construction and object initialization.

risk.why: A bug would only cause unit test failures in miniminer_tests.

summary: Replaces the resize-and-index assignment in the `make_tx` helper within `miniminer_tests.cpp` with `emplace_back` for inputs and `std::vector::assign` with a `CTxOut` constructor call for outputs. The constructed test transactions and test execution remain unchanged.
